subject: CAIQ: runtime residency & evidence orchestration for private deploy
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@greenridge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ runtime residency evidence for private deploy

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As we scope GreenRidge's CAIQ submission for the Private deployment (on-prem + VPC hybrid), our compliance team needs a focused mapping for the following residency/runtime items:

- Data residency controls (where runtime logs, KV cache, and model artifacts are stored)
- Runtime telemetry and sampling proof (traces, tokenization logs, anonymization steps)
- Keystore/HSM rotation evidence and operator access logs
- Network segmentation and enclave diagrams for on-prem nodes

Can you provide a short package we can ingest (mapping matrix + representative artifacts)? Ideally: an index spreadsheet, diagram(s), a few redacted log samples, and the keystore rotation audit. We have a procurement timeline too — procurement will ask for a PO and signed terms once the CAIQ scope is agreed.

Target dates: we need a draft evidence bundle by Tue, Jul 6 (two weeks). Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Director, Audits — GreenRidge Financial

Attachments requested: runtime-evidence-index.xlsx (index), network-segmentation-diagram.png
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@greenridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ runtime residency evidence for private deploy

Sam —

Appreciate the clear ask. We're aligned to put together a compact bundle for the items you listed. Proposed plan and owners:

1) Evidence index (runtime-evidence-index.xlsx) — owner: Kimberly Park. Contains CAIQ control IDs, evidence filename, short description, and caveats for redaction.
2) Network/enclave diagram (network-segmentation-diagram.png + PDF variants) — owner: Jordan Blake. Will include VPC boundaries, on-prem rack segmentation, and enclave overlay.
3) Keystore/HSM rotation audit (keystore-rotation-audit.pdf) — owner: Security Ops; will include last 12 months rotation records and operator access log excerpt.
4) Runtime logs / telemetry samples — owner: Infra/Observability. We'll provide redacted tokenization traces and a KV cache sample demonstrating tenant key separation.

Feasibility: can deliver a draft bundle by Tue, Jul 6. Two asks from your side to speed review:
- Confirm whether you need raw log lines or redacted/sampled extracts (we recommend sampled extracts for privacy).
- Confirm if you want DocuSign routing for the procurement/terms after scope sign-off (we can generate a PO-ready packet).

I will attach the evidence index and the initial network diagram in the next message (working drafts).

Regards,
Monica Patel
Solutions Lead, Compliance Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs referenced: runtime-evidence-index.xlsx, network-segmentation-diagram.png
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@greenridge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ runtime residency evidence for private deploy

Sam / team —

Attached is the first-pass evidence index (runtime-evidence-index.xlsx) and a high-level PDF of the network overlay. A few notes in-line:

- CAIQ mapping: I added CSA control IDs in column B and marked items that are partial ("P") vs full coverage ("F").
- Keystore evidence: keystore-rotation-audit.pdf is uploaded to the shared drive link (sensitive). We'll provide a redacted PDF excerpt here; full audit will be provided under an NDA/secure portal.
- Runtime telemetry: we are providing sampled traces (txn-id samples) with tenant IDs hashed. Raw logs are available in the secured evidence vault if you require them for audit sampling.
- KV cache proof: included snippet shows tenant key isolation and TTL behavior; this maps to CCM controls for cache isolation.

Caveats: A small set of controls (mainly around on-prem physical access logs and third-party hardware HSM vendor receipts) will need confirmation from Security Ops — expected by Fri, Jul 2.

Next steps: Monica / Jordan and I can do a short walkthrough on Wed (30 min) to confirm the mapping before we finalize the bundle.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Compliance Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments included: runtime-evidence-index.xlsx, network-segmentation-diagram.png
Drive link (internal): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/GR-4821/evidence-index
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@greenridge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@greenridge.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ runtime residency evidence for private deploy

Team —

Thanks, Kimberly — the index and diagram look good as a start. A couple of quick clarifications:

1) Redacted extracts are fine for our initial CAIQ intake; we will request limited raw samples during the audit window if necessary.
2) For the keystore audit, please share the redacted PDF now and indicate process to request full artifacts (we use a secure SFTP for large transfers).
3) Procurement has been looped in — procurement will issue a PO upon scope sign-off. We prefer DocuSign for contractual routing.

Procurement (procurement@greenridge.com) — can you confirm PO cadence and any vendor registration items you need from Redwood?

Sam Turner
Director, Audits — GreenRidge Financial
